mentions.name: Neelcamp
mentions.description: This app helps parents get reminders (and potentially auto-book, if possible) before kids' summer camps fill up, aiming to reduce the stress of missed camp registration deadlines.
mentions.problem: Every year parents miss their kids' summer camp deadlines or scramble to grab whatever spots are left once camps fill up.
mentions.audience: Parents who miss kids' summer camp registration deadlines
mentions.source_excerpt:
I figured there has to be a better way — so I’m building something that helps parents like us get reminders (and maybe even auto-book if this is possible) before camps fill up.

If you’ve been through this rodeo too, please provide your feedback — your feedback will help make next summer a lot less stressful for other parents

https://neelcamp.com/
